title: Pan-Fried Dumplings
description: A classic Chinese dish featuring pan-fried dumplings filled with a mix of pork and vegetables.
instructions: 1. In a large pan or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the dumplings to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
3. Remove the dumplings from the pan and set them aside.
4. In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
5. Add the chopped scallions and minced garlic to the pan and stir-fry for 1 minute.
6. Return the dumplings to the pan and add the soy sauce. Stir-fry for another minute.
7. Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
